mapper.select: SELECT b.book_id, b.book_title, b.book_author, b.book_price, b.book_summary, b.book_cover, g.genre_id, g.genre_name, b.book_stock, b.book_publisher, b.book_flag FROM books AS b JOIN genres AS g ON b.book_genre = g.genre_id ORDER BY b.book_id LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{pageCount}
SELECT * FROM genres ORDER BY genre_id
